book.title: Prophet Moses (pbuh): The Cruel King and the Sea (A1)

pages.title: The Cruel King
pages.content:
Moses (pbuh) was a great Messenger of Allah. He lived in Egypt more than 3,000 years ago. The king of Egypt was Pharaoh. He was a cruel king. He did not believe in Allah. He said, “I am your god.”

A big group of people lived in Egypt. They were the Children of Israel. They believed in Allah. They were a very big group, so the king was afraid of them. He made them work very hard for no money.

One night, the king had a bad dream. He told his wise men the dream, and they were afraid. His wise men told him, “A boy from the Children of Israel will take your country from you.” The king was angry. He said, “Take all the baby boys of the Children of Israel away.”

Think that something is true.

pages.title: A Baby on the River
pages.content:
That year, baby Moses was born. His mother was very afraid. She asked Allah for help. Allah told her to put the baby in a basket. Allah said, “Do not be afraid. Put the basket in the river. We will protect him.” She put the basket on the River Nile. The water took it away. Moses’s mother was very worried. She said to her daughter, “Go after the basket and watch it.”

The basket came near the king’s palace. The king’s family found the baby. The queen, Asiya, loved the baby. She was a good woman. She said, “Do not hurt him. He can be our son.”

pages.title: Back to His Mother
pages.content:
The baby was hungry. He did not drink milk from any woman. Moses’s sister came to the palace. She said, “I know a good woman. She can give milk to the baby.” Then she brought her own mother!

Allah gave baby Moses back to his mother. His mother was very happy. Allah’s promise was true. Moses grew up in the palace. He became a strong young man. He always helped weak people.

pages.title: A Mistake in the Market
pages.content:
One day, Moses saw two men in the market. They were fighting. One man was from Egypt. The other man was from the Children of Israel. “Help me!” the man shouted. Moses hit the man from Egypt one time. The man fell and died.

Moses did not want this. He was very sad. He said, “Allah, please forgive me.” Allah forgave him. Then a man came and said, “The king’s soldiers are looking for you. Go away from here!”

pages.title: The Two Sisters
pages.content:
Moses left Egypt. He walked for many days. He came to Midian. He was tired and thirsty. He found a well. Many shepherds were there with their sheep.

Two girls stood far from the well. Moses asked, “Why are you waiting?” They said, “Our father is very old. We wait for the shepherds to go.” Moses helped them. He gave water to their sheep.

The girls came home early. Their old father was surprised, so he asked, “Why are you here early?” The girls told their father about Moses. Their father asked Moses to come to his house. He gave Moses a job. Later, Moses married one of the sisters. They lived in Midian for ten years.

pages.title: The Voice on the Mountain
pages.content:
Moses and his family decided to go back to Egypt. It was winter. It was dark and cold. Then Moses saw a fire on a mountain. He said to his family, “Wait here! I will bring fire.” He went up the mountain.

There, Moses heard a voice: “O Moses, I am Allah.” Allah chose Moses as His Messenger. Allah told Moses to put his stick down. The stick turned into a big snake! Then Allah told Moses to go to Pharaoh. Pharaoh was a cruel king. So, Allah told Moses to talk to him and show him the right way. His brother Aaron went with him.

pages.title: The Magicians
pages.content:
Moses and Aaron went to the palace. Moses said to Pharaoh, “I am a Messenger of Allah.” Pharaoh did not believe him. He wanted a sign. So, Moses decided to show Allah’s power. He threw his stick down. It turned into a snake. Pharaoh said, “This is only magic.” He called all his magicians. They threw sticks and ropes on the floor. They looked like snakes.

Then Moses threw his stick. It turned into a very big snake. It ate all the magicians’ snakes! The magicians understood. They said, “We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Moses and Aaron.” But Pharaoh did not believe.

pages.title: The Night Journey
pages.content:
After that day, Pharaoh was more cruel to Moses’s people. He made their lives harder. Allah told Moses to leave Egypt at night. Moses said to his people, “Get ready. We are going tonight.”

They left at night. There were many old people and children. They walked slowly. In the morning, they came to the sea. They looked back. Pharaoh and his big army were behind them! The people were very afraid. They said, “They are going to catch us!”

But Moses said, “No! My Lord is with me. He will show me the way.”

pages.title: The Sea Opens
pages.content:
Allah told Moses to hit the sea with his stick. Moses hit the sea, and the sea opened! The water stood up like two big walls. There was a road between them, with no water on it. Moses and his people walked to the other side safely.

Pharaoh and his soldiers went after them into the sea. Then the water closed over them. Pharaoh and his soldiers died in the sea.

The story of Moses teaches us lessons. Bad people can be very strong, but Allah is stronger. Only Allah has all the power.

places.name: Egypt
places.text: Moses (pbuh) lived in Egypt more than 3,000 years ago. Pharaoh was the king of Egypt. He was a cruel king.
places.teacherNote: The A1 text does not name a city or say where the palace was.
places.question: Who was the king of Egypt?

places.name: The River Nile
places.text: Moses’s mother put her baby in a basket. She put the basket on the River Nile. The water took it away.
places.teacherNote: The text does not say where on the Nile this happened.
places.question: What did Moses’s mother put on the river?

places.name: Midian
places.text: Moses left Egypt. He walked for many days. He came to Midian. He lived there for ten years.
places.teacherNote: The A1 text does not say where Midian was. Many sources place it east of the Gulf of Aqaba.
places.question: How long did Moses live in Midian?

places.name: The Mountain
places.text: Moses and his family decided to go back to Egypt. It was dark and cold. Moses saw a fire on a mountain. There, he heard a voice.
places.teacherNote: The A1 text does not name this mountain. The B2 book calls it Mount Sinai (Mount Tur).
places.question: What did Moses see on the mountain?

places.name: The Sea
places.text: Moses and his people left Egypt at night. In the morning, they came to the sea. The sea opened, and they walked to the other side.
places.teacherNote: The A1 text does not name the sea. The B1 and B2 books call it the Red Sea.
places.question: When did they come to the sea?

pages.title: Language Review
pages.content: Review the language from all chapters.

exercises.title: Look: Two Kinds of Past
exercises.instructions: Put each verb in the right group.
exercises.question: How does each verb show the past?
exercises.explanation: Many verbs add -ed: live → lived, help → helped. Some verbs change: take → took, find → found, see → saw, throw → threw.

feedback.correct: Well done. You found the two kinds of past.
feedback.incorrect: Say the verb today: live, take … Does it add -ed or change?

exercises.title: Practise: Was or Were
exercises.question: One or many?

formChoices.sentence: Many shepherds [choice] there with their sheep.

exercises.explanation: One person: was. Two or more: were.

feedback.incorrect: Mother = one. Shepherds = many.

exercises.title: Practise: Did Not
exercises.question: Which form is right?

formChoices.sentence: The baby [choice] milk from any woman.

exercises.explanation: After did not, use the verb with no change: did not believe, did not drink.

feedback.incorrect: Did not + believe, drink.

exercises.title: Practise: Do This!
exercises.instructions: Fill the gaps with the words.
exercises.question: What did they say?
exercises.fillBlanksText: The king said, “[blank] all the baby boys away.” The mother said, “[blank] after the basket.” Moses said, “[blank] here.”
exercises.explanation: Start with the verb: Take, Go, Wait.

feedback.incorrect: Find these words in Chapters 1, 2 and 6.

exercises.title: Practise: Fix One Word
exercises.instructions: Find the wrong word. Write the right word.
exercises.question: Which word is wrong?

errorItems.sentence: The water taked the basket away.

exercises.explanation: “Throw” and “take” change in the past: threw, took.

feedback.incorrect: Throw → threw. Take → took. They do not take -ed.

exercises.title: Use: Me and My Family
exercises.instructions: Write three sentences about your family.
exercises.question: Who is in your family?
exercises.explanation: Use was / were, one past verb and one -er word.

discussionPrompts.question: One “was / were”: “My grandfather was …”
discussionPrompts.example: My grandfather was a teacher.

discussionPrompts.question: One past verb: “Last year, we …”
discussionPrompts.example: Last year, we visited Konya.

discussionPrompts.question: One “-er than”: “My … is …er than …”
discussionPrompts.example: My father is taller than my mother.
